nodes.label: Which staffing option provides weekly support capacity of at least 100 tickets per week?
Additional capacity with no additional specialists

staleness.limitation: Hash equality cannot detect brief, framing or stage changes.

cell.face: ‘Keep current staffing’: 0% chance of ‘Weekly support capacity’ being at least 100 ticket / week at 1 week from now, in this model, if ‘Weekly capacity per additional specialist’ follows Olumi’s provisional conversion of your range, 10 ticket / week / specialist to 30 ticket / week / specialist, into a bell-shaped spread, held within those bounds.

detail.precision_words: Simulation precision: exact. Every simulated draw gives the same result for this option, so no sampling is involved.

cell.face: ‘Add one specialist’: about 50% chance of ‘Weekly support capacity’ being at least 100 ticket / week at 1 week from now, in this model, if ‘Weekly capacity per additional specialist’ follows Olumi’s provisional conversion of your range, 10 ticket / week / specialist to 30 ticket / week / specialist, into a bell-shaped spread, held within those bounds.

detail.precision_words: Simulation precision: 48.8% to 50.8%, from 10,000 simulated draws. This is how exactly the simulation measured the chance, not a range the chance could take.

goal_chance.chance_words: chance of ‘Weekly support capacity’ being at least 100 ticket / week at 1 week from now
